status_vocabulary.client_contribution: Material supplied to the expert; not an expert conclusion unless authorship is independently established.
status_vocabulary.draft: The located copy identifies itself as draft or lacks matched final/signature evidence.
status_vocabulary.signed_final: A final or signed version is located.
status_vocabulary.transmitted: Transmission is documented; transmission alone is not court filing.
status_vocabulary.selected_as_annex: Counsel or a pleading identifies the document as an annex to a defined filing.
status_vocabulary.court_filed: A filing receipt, official bundle, docket entry or judicial source confirms incorporation into a defined court file.
status_vocabulary.court_cited: A judicial decision or official hearing record expressly refers to or uses the report.
status_vocabulary.author_reported_filed: The author later recalled that the item was filed; independent court-file confirmation remains required.
status_vocabulary.court_confirmed_role: A court-originating source confirms the person's procedural role.
status_vocabulary.unresolved: The available source set does not support a definitive proposition.

publication_controls: Do not collapse creation, signature, custody, transmission, receipt, annex selection, filing, timeliness and judicial use.
Do not label an item extemporaneous unless the applicable deadline and actual filing or service date establish lateness.
Do not describe the court-supplied optical medium as corrupt, defective, manipulated or incomplete on the located record.
Do not state that Espejo definitely testified without reviewing the filed versions; the precise pre-evidence review position remains unresolved.
Do not state that all four signed final reports were four separate annexes to LPB's April 2019 opposition.
Do not state that the two other signed finals were never used or filed elsewhere.
Do not equate the retrospectively mentioned May economic note with the 10 May valuation draft without an exact document match.
Do not allege audiovisual manipulation, deletion or incompleteness without originals, metadata, hashes and/or a certified court copy.
Do not publish private contacts, fees, family information, privileged strategy or complete restricted reports without separate clearance.
Expert evidence is not adjudication and does not by itself establish misconduct, knowledge, causation, liability or criminal intent.
